reviews.review_text: My husband and I enjoy trying local cuisine and new experiences with dining options. Well this place is certainly one of those places. The menu is thoughtful and exciting but not overly daring. The food is Peruvian but with international influences. And yet they offer a classic flan that I swear is the BEST you’ll ever have!!! The ambience is great for a couple or small group in this quaint setting. The experience will be unforgettable for sure!!
reviews.title: A truly unique dining experience you won’t want to pass up while you’re enjoying your stay in Lima, Peru.

reviews.review_text: We had a excellent lunch experience. After eating two tasting menus in a row, we switched to à la cart in the morning. We are super grateful for that. We’re also thankful that the staff was so easy to accommodate us. The à la carte menu has a lot of different options. The waitress was able to make recommendations on what we should order. The scallops with sankey is definitely a must have. I probably could’ve eaten another couple of those. It was so light and refreshing. The Popeye crab was also very interesting with almost thai flavors, very balanced. The fish curry was cooked perfectly. The different flavors mixed with the pani puri bread was super fun. The rice with squid was also very well thought out. The fresh peas added the texture that it needed. It was a homey and very thoughtful dish. Thankfully, we received room for dessert. The flan is the best flan I’ve ever had in my entire life. The custard was luxurious and luscious on the tongue. Definitely a highlight. The grilled custard apple with such an interesting dish. It was fun to eat and had a great almost pancake toast on the bottom, topped with a grilled custard, apple, topped with a crisp of the custard apple. On the side, there was almost this goat cheese/funky ice cream, which really complimented everything. It was by far one of the most interesting and flavorful dishes.
reviews.title: Highly enjoyable

reviews.review_text: Situated in a central side street in Barranco this is a delight to visit. There is a tasting menu which looked substantial so we went with the a la carte. This grilled scallops were two perfect mouthfuls, the sweetbreads- the best I have ever had, the lamb could be but with a spoon and the belly pork perfect. The servers were engaging and not imposing. Exceptional value my best meals in Peru. Suits a Western palate well
reviews.title: This place is superb even though it was recommended by Giles Coren!

reviews.review_text:
The
Food is exquisite, awesome, Service is good but I feel like they want to sell you the most expensive part of the menu, wine suggestions were not so good having some options, I went with tourist friends and well the
We have a good time in general, many times we must see the need of people before offering the top brands, then all well.
reviews.title: Watch out.

reviews.review_text: Without a doubt the best meal of my life.  I do not say that lightly as I live in New Orleans and have been to many fabulous restaurants there.  I also have lived in Philly and travel so have had the privilege to try many restaurants other places.  Flavors were out of this world and the combinations of food, flavor, and texture was outstanding.  We also did the South American wine pairing which was the perfect compliment to every course.  Staff were the ultimate professionals.  This in itself would have made for the most memorable night on our trip, but when we struggled to catch an uber due to no international cell service plus construction in the area Chef Martinez himself came out to help us, walked 2 blocks with us, and only left once we got into the car.  So not only is he one of the best chefs in the world but a kind and helpful man at his core.  If you travel to Lima your trip will not be complete without a stop at Merito.
reviews.title: Best meal of my life

reviews.review_text: Best meal in Lima, hands down. I unfortunately did not do many other fine dining or highly acclaimed restaurants during my trip, but Merito exceeded already high expectations. Each dish was an adventure: beautifully presented and all tastes amazing. Some dishes surprised me with textures and flavors. The service was attentive and very professional. The cocktails were fantastic. Ambience and music very tasteful. Price is amazing for what you get. Highly recommended
reviews.title: Amazing

reviews.review_text: This is an amazing experience and journey through creation and flavours! Just amazing. We set at the kitchen counter and watched art with culinary come together!
reviews.title: Amazing experience

reviews.review_text: This was one of the most amazing lunches I ever had to be able to combine delicious and beautiful food and healthy. All at once is truly an art on top of being very fast as well. I didn’t want it to end. Wish I had somebody there with me so I can taste more of their menu. It’s just so much you could eat when you’re by yourself. It was a very buried special restaurant coming from a person that ate all over the world truly amazing not recommended for the backpacker budget
reviews.title: I would give it a Michelin star

reviews.review_text: Merito was an excellent experience in fusion food. The atmosphere was casual. The wait staff were excellent. They explained each dish. Gave recommendations and were there to answer any questions. I would highly recommend Merito. The food presentation was unique and food was delicious.
reviews.title: Merito a great fusion food experience

reviews.review_text:
I start from food: as per the title, acidity. Nothing more. Each dish had a constant, this acidity foretold so much that, at the end of the ten courses, it was all so obvious in taste that boredom had taken over. Every single dish ended with this sour tone and all this was repeated again and again. 

Atmosphere: Medium/high music and very loud cold air conditioning made the room uncomfortable. Beautiful lighting. 

Service: our table was tied, for service, to another table, so, if we had not yet finished the other table had to wait and vice versa. In addition, we were served by 4 different waiters who could not explain the ingredients used (except superficially) while the explanation of the ingredients was supposed to be the main focus of this experience. 

Disappointment is so much also because it seems to enter a temple of cuisine and everything tries to be so perfect that then at the end of dinner you do not have much left except, precisely, this immense disappointment. The price is high, the disappointment more!
reviews.title: Acidity

reviews.review_text:
This was bought as a 40th wedding anniversary gift by our 3 adult kids as they knew that we were coming to Peru and our son had eaten there a few years before.
The building is unusual in that you walk through the kitchen with a chefs table and taken upstairs to the restaurant itself. It does have the industrial vibe with bare bricks etc but our table and chairs were comfortable. We were having the 10 course tasting menu and the staff were very attentive to my allergen request of no onions. 
Each course was fantastic with Peruvian ingredients the majority we had never heard of. The flavours were amazing as well as having playful variations in texture and colours. Each course was explained by the staff with advice how to eat it to get the most out of each course.
By the sixth course I was feeling full and was worrying whether I would be able to finish the menu but the chef’s playfulness came into its own and I finished the meal just right.
We had a bottle of Albariño which complemented the food. 

The meal was simply stunning on all levels and entered my top 10 meals eaten out and we have eaten in quite a few Michelin star restaurants including Arzak, Gordon Ramseys and L’Enclume and is was as good as them.

Sat near us was an American guy sat by himself having the same menu taking photos.
We met him outside and had a quick chat about the meal. He had visited a  world renowned restaurant around the corner and said this meal was one third of the price and twice as good- I think that summed up the whole experience for us.
reviews.title: Fantastic, amazing, sensational….I could go on.

reviews.review_text: Merito is a must-visit in Lima! The food is exquisite-each dish bursting with flavor and beautifully presented. The service was top-notch, and the staff’s recommendations were spot on. The chefs went above and beyond by customizing non-veg dishes into delicious vegetarian options. A perfect blend of creativity, taste, and warm hospitality. 💖
reviews.title: Exquisite Flavors & Outstanding Service at Merito

reviews.review_text:
We had looked forward to our trip to Merito for several months and once we’d arrived in Peru , our anticipation grew as we found the incredible level of respect found across the whole country for ingredients. Peru is not known as the garden of South America for nothing, with the variety of ecosystems that support multitudes of flora & fauna.

 Chef Juan Luis Martinez, graciously allowed us to take our tasting menu at the bar in the kitchen and watching the team at work in their creation of the dishes that we were to consume was a fantastic experience. A menu that takes modern and classic cooking techniques with a laser like focus on ingredients. You’re hard put to find a superfluous ingredient on a plate here. Everything has a place and a reason for its inclusion.

We both took the tasting menu, a representation of around 10 courses that take you on a journey inspired both by the chef’s Venezuelan heritage in addition to the Peruvian backscape of ingredients available. The Coast, the Amazon & The Andes provided Swordfish. Crab, Scallops and Lobster, Paiche ( a large freshwater fish) and young Goat for us together with a selection of tubers, quinoas and vegetables some of which I had never come across previously, to create a menu which  represented the best of Peru & Venezuela  in both technique and combination. The light smoke given to most dishes by virtue of the carob tree wood glowing in the oven gave a light but intense addition to dishes which was well received. I also took the Wine pairing to accompany the menu, a voyage which took us all over South America from Peru to Uruguay to Argentina & Chile with wines that were challenging but never to the point of disrupting the balance and harmony with their accompanying dishes. Often small or even micro producers. The wine pairing had obviously been considered at length and much like the menu everything had a reason & rationale for being there.

This was an epic journey and whilst one might easily think that this was entirely led by the dishes presented. Our waiter with his intimate knowledge of the dishes meant that rather than just reeling off a list of ingredients (as is often found in good restaurants) we were given deep descriptions of cooking techniques, sourcing of ingredients and more which gave a significantly deeper understanding and thus enjoyment of everything we ate. Supplemented by the Sommeliers previously noted excellent wine choices and informative descriptions, made for a more than excellent evening. Merito provides excellent value for a restaurant of its calibre but do not mistake value for any loss of quality. From someone who has been fortunate enough to visit a significant number of Michelin starred and highly rated restaurants, The gastronomic journey to be found at Merito is one of the best!
reviews.title: Sensational dinner!!

reviews.review_text:
Former Central chef.  Excellent a la carte Venezuelan Peruvian cuisine. Loved the food here.  Lunch or dinner.  Has a walk in kitchen counter also. 

Service: impeccable and friendly.  English speaking staff.
reviews.title: One of the Best New Restaurants in Peru

reviews.review_text:
What a great experience! We were visiting Lima for a few days  post a tour of Peru! We love good food. We were not disappointed. The restaurant is located in the trendy area, Barranco. The restaurant is humble and minimalist in its decor with a ‘cool’ relaxing vibe. The staff greeted us warmly and were super helpful about the menu and drinks. We had the following and loved everything:

Pez & Kiwicha
Mamet & Cangrejo popeye
Conchas, Sandi & Jalapeño
Choclo al la brasa
Cabrita & Tuberculos
El Flan
Roca 

The quality and presentation was high and the incredible flavour combinations. The recommended wine by the sommelier was perfect. (Vigo carignan). So glad we could visit. Highly recommended.
reviews.title: Amazing place

reviews.review_text: We were lucky to get a seat at the bar without a reservation. The bar seats were not super comfortable but the service, food and atmosphere were so good that we didn't care all that much. The drink service was interesting with unusual and well-crafted cocktails and a nice selection of wines. There were also interesting non-alcoholic drinks. We had two appetizers, one was a remarkable concoction with different types of corn that was incredibly complex and delicious, the other was scallops with sanki and jalapeno that were super fresh and perfect. We had pork belly, perfectly cooked and served with puffy arepas to stuff it into along with a couple of sauces and lightly pickled cabbage. and we had the fish of the day; a pacific white fish that was perfectly cooked and came with a delicious Peruvian black mint sauce. The chocolate rock and the, if I remeber correctly, Cherimoya cherimoya cherimoya - three varieties of dessert featuring the fruit, were both superb. I'm not sure how much good knowing what we ate will do you; the menu changes frequently. I am looking forward to going back.
reviews.title: Great interesting restaurant with local ingredients.

reviews.review_text:
The positives:
The room is lovely, with a bit of an industrial vibe. 
The food is beautiful presented. 
Service is attentive.

The not so good:
The air con fans spew very cold air on your neck, suffered from a headache the entire day after (no, I didn’t drink too much). 
Some of the sauces with the main courses are way too salty. At a certain point I couldn’t even taste the nuances of the dishes, all I could taste was salt. 
No real vegetables in the dishes. 
Reading the menu it’s a bit hard to gauge how large the portions may be, making it difficult to know how much to order. 
A couple of dishes weren’t described properly by the server, ended up ordering a frozen dessert concoction when I was already cold, just because the words “cold” or “frozen” were never used.
reviews.title: A mixed experience

reviews.review_text:
The food was delicious. Octopus, gizzards, fish... I ate better but rich, nothing to say.
But wines, really, too expensive for quality. 
An intikalpa, s/150 when you find s/32 in wong... no.
reviews.title: WINE PRICES

reviews.review_text: From Colombia I was clear that I should come to this restaurant, the expectation was high and still exceeded it. The service is wonderful and they explain in detail each dish. I recommend it with a closed eye.
reviews.title: Wonderful.

reviews.review_text: Great tasty innovative food. One of the top 5 meals of our lives. Food was not only visually amazing but tasty as well. The flan is amazing. Make your reservations early - it is a small restaurant. Service is amazing - one of the servers noticed we were hesitating on the sidewalk after dinner - our Uber had pulled up across the street - he came out and stopped traffic for us and escorted us over to the Uber - amazing.
reviews.title: One of the best meals of our life

reviews.review_text:
The atmosphere super.the dark wood part warmer, although for breakfast ideal the clarita. Comfortable chairs and beautiful tableware
Very very good service and food worthy of paradise
reviews.title: Food worthy of paradise

reviews.review_text:
Simple, but cozy environment, we were treated by Sofia, a Russian who was enchanted with Lima and did not want to return to her Christmas land.
I recommend the Polvo with well Peruvian spices and sweet potato with Palta.
reviews.title: I recommend this restaurant, its variety of dishes are very limited, of course at dinner can change, since I went to lunch.

reviews.review_text:
My husband and I visited Merito for a lunch date.

It was the last of the top 50 restaurants in the world located in Lima we were yet to try and expectations were high.

The restaurant is located in a traditional shop in Barranco, just around the corner from Central and Kjolle.

The entrance is through the open kitchen and then you get promptly taken to the table upstairs.

There are two rooms with 6 tables each (quite close to each other). The style is smart casual and the crowd is very trendy.

We opted for a selection of dishes which we shared, accompanied by wine (there is no matching, you pick wine by glass or go for a bottle).

We thought that Scallops, sanki and jalapeños & white fish with cocoa fruit were good,  octopus, fish curry and arepas were fantastic and so was flan (one of the best I’ve ever had). Coconut dessert was average and so was the wine selection by glass.

Overall we had a nice afternoon, ate well and thought it was value for money (£170 for two, including 3 glasses of wine each & teas and coffees)
reviews.title: Meal with a lot of potential

reviews.review_text: * Merit - located in the “young” neighborhood called “barrancas” the merit offers a tapas style menu. Small dishes to divide. We ordered the corn, the popai crab, and the entrance caterpillars. Tasty, but nothing spectacular. The crab, in particular, had a strange taste. The best are the main dishes, highlighting the pork and the curry’ fish that were great. It is among the 7 best in Latin America according to expert critics. Price below the average of the others. It is worth going there and dps go pro bar Ayuhasca, which is in the same neighborhood. Ps: bons drinks
reviews.title: Young Restaurant

reviews.review_text:
I loved everything about our dinner at Merito. The ambiance and music are relaxed and chic, and my husband and I were blown away by the food. 

The crackers with Andean grains and white fish and the seafood curry were outstanding, and we had a ceviche with a fruit we've never tried before that was excellent. If you are a pescatarian or a fan of fresh fish you must try Merito! The value is also excellent-we didn't pay much more than we would for a standard dinner out in NYC and everything about our experience was exceptional. 

I had an excellent cocktail with coconut and cardamom. The N/A cocktail options were also sophisticated and the one my husband ordered was delicious. 

The service is also top-notch. Alexandra was especially helpful and patient answering our many questions and gently offering recommendations. 

Even among the countless excellent dining options in Lima I would absolutely go back to Merito, and I will be dreaming out it until then!
reviews.title: creative & outstanding food and cocktails, beautiful ambiance and top-notch service

reviews.review_text: Feels like fine dining but in a relaxed, casual setting. Instead of a tasting menu, you can choose from a variety of dishes on the menu. The staff was attentive and so helpful with recommendations. Everything we tried was outstanding. Our top picks are the fish curry, which we almost skipped but were convinced to order by wait staff—we were blown away. And the flan is TO DIE FOR! Merito is a must-visit!
reviews.title: What an incredible experience!

reviews.review_text:
Hard to describe such an eye-catching experience 
A very careful staging in every detail. Balanced flavors that flow and magically combine 
Presentation, tableware, explanation of the garzona a luxury
Greatly exceeded expectations
reviews.title: A poem

reviews.review_text:
It was a wonderful experience 
At the end of our Peruvian trip we have lunch in this simple, beautiful, contemporary place.
We took all the starters and some of the desserts 
This gastronomic trip was a pleasure and impeccable service
reviews.title: Waouhhhhh!!!!

reviews.review_text: Delicious food, a surprise to every dish the drinks are reasonable I found a little strong mainly for the female audience the service left to be desired of the staff that receives the customers, we arrived very early and without Reservation the young man who works receiving the customers did not explain right that we would stay in the bar and there even dinner being there were several empty tables but outside it was worth the experience.
reviews.title: Good experience

reviews.review_text:
Exquisite,  delicious,  humbling.
Excellent service 
Amazing, cozy, friendly, little restaurant 
Inspiring
Perfect balance of acidity to enhance local flavours
An absolute pleasure
reviews.title: Exquisite,  delicious,  Humbling

reviews.review_text: Amazing restaurant - well worth the international price tag! We were on a tour and had a free night for dinner.  One of our traveling companions is a big foodie and heard about Merito.  It did not disappoint.  From the quaint space, to the handmade dishes, to the fantastic service and of course the food, it was a very special evening.  I highly recommend trying this when in Lima!
reviews.title: Special Restaurant in Lima!

reviews.review_text:
Spectacular experience! Of the best!
Cook to another level, with details, unmatched flavors, very well served!
Tremendous dining experience.
Author cuisine, delicious EVERYTHING.
We book in advance! And it was 100% worth it.
reviews.title: Spectacular dining experience!

reviews.review_text: Absolutely incredible food. Everything we had was cooked to perfection, incredibly flavourful, surprising, beyond wonderful. If I could give it 10 stars, I would. I am a big foodie and passionate home cook and have had the pleasure of having eaten at some incredible places. Mérito takes the crown.
reviews.title: Do not miss this place

reviews.review_text: We are big food people and this place blew us away. Incredible food, drinks and the price to quality ratio is outstanding. I would make a reservation! Would definitely go back.
reviews.title: 10 stars

reviews.review_text: Amazing quality and really delicious restaurant in Barranco. They are not a showy place. It’s just amazing ingredients executed to perfection.  Highly recommend. Best flan of my life.
reviews.title: Go for the quality and food. It’s so good

reviews.review_text:
a marvel ; the atmosphere, the attention, the cuisine, the drinks
Incredible scallops with huacatay, octopus and desserts!!
a section for the friendly, but not overbearing, staff, who explain what is necessary for you to enjoy it to the fullest
reviews.title: unmissable in ravine

reviews.review_text:
Beautiful food presentation, exquisite food served on simple plates. Service was quiet and discreet and wine recommendations were perfect. 
Totally Gluten Free friendly - I was able to share all of the plates that we the family chose together, which is unusual. 
The little starters, crab, fresh fish and mix of local fruits and vegetables were delicious. The lamb and tubers, catch of the day and pork dish with small corn like pitta breads were excellent. I cannot recommend this wonderful restaurant experience enough. The corn and coffee desert was like nothing we have ever tried and was just delicious.
reviews.title: Amazing !!!

reviews.review_text: Really good worth every penny. Best service in the world. Very tasty food. Not pretentious. Everything tastes delicious but avodlid carbs so you can try more things
reviews.title: Go there

reviews.review_text: An excellent experience. Merit has a more intimate atmosphere, with excellent execution. The food was sensational, the best I've ever eaten in my life. I also liked the service.
reviews.title: Great

reviews.review_text: Excellence needs few words. Fantastic food. Small and refined place without being pretentious. The same can be said for the service. It's worth the whole price.
reviews.title: Simply fantastic!

reviews.review_text:
The food without words is sensational,
Congratulations to the Chefs, everything is delicious. Service is confusing and poor. I asked the waiter about the orange wine and he told me that it was a natural wine and that I wasn't used to it. (Apparently he knows me and knows what I drink). I asked for water and they brought imported water (one thing that really irritates me is paying more for water, the tables with foreigners serve imported water and the local tables serve national water). The restaurant is no longer cheap, there is no need to force the customer to pay more for water, which, by the way, does not even have a price on the menu. I had to get up to serve my wine because the bottle was far away and out of 4 waiters, none for 10 minutes were able to serve the wine. My husband went there and served. I gave up trying dessert. In short, excellent food, poor service and priceless water on the menu. Of all the 50 best that I visited, by far the worst service.
reviews.title: Amazing food and poor service!

reviews.review_text:
Absolutely recommended!
Great service,
Experimental but tasty food 😋sabroso
All dishes are finely decorated and the quantity is perfect.
We were at (Central by Virgilio) in December 2022
It was a total disappointment.
Merit is mega hyper top recommended.
reviews.title: Heavenly delicious

reviews.review_text: We were only in Lima for one day and had high expectations for Merito. Unfortunately we were very disappointed. The starter sweet bread flavour was not memorable and very average food. The main course pork belly was not succulent and a bit dry. The flavour was a bit blend. Will not recommend
reviews.title: Disappointed experience

reviews.review_text: An amazing culinary adventure where the wait staff are your culinary expert and sommelier all in one. Décor is minimalistic but warm. Restaurant is cozy with less than 15 tables. Our BEST culinary experience in Lima
reviews.title: Thé Best Culinary Experience by far

reviews.review_text: Renowned Lime culinary address, Merito will not have disappointed us! We tasted 5 steps away from 7 starters and main courses, before moving on to desserts. Each dish brings an explosion of flavors and sensations in the mouth, obtained by a successful fusion of Peruvian and Venezuelan cuisines! And each is preceded by a detailed explanation of its composition and how to taste it.
reviews.title: Unforgettable culinary experience in Lima

reviews.review_text:
I started with pisco cocktail with cherimoya and we moved on to wine. The first thing we did was reserve the flan for dessert, just in case.
The dishes arrived without stress so that they were kept at their temperature. Very good fish with quinoa, shells, fish curry, lamb and sweetbreads. Oh, and the octopus. To repeat, without a doubt.
Very good service.
reviews.title: Haute cuisine at a reasonable price

reviews.review_text: I went to dinner with my husband to celebrate my birthday. Book way in advance (more than a week, at least), if there are more than 2 people. Beautiful place, with impeccably designed interior architecture and utensils. Excellent service and one of the best gastronomic experiences of our lives. Please try the flan!
reviews.title: Deserves to be on the list of the 50 best in Latin America

reviews.review_text: Our late lunch experience at this restaurant was truly exceptional, ranking among the top we've encountered worldwide. The chef's personal touch, guiding us through the culinary journey, added a special touch. The unique and thoughtful flavors, coupled with impeccable presentation, made it a remarkable and memorable gastronomic adventure.
reviews.title: A must go….

reviews.review_text: This place was beyond amazing! From the location in old Barranco suburb to the old renovated building, the furniture, staff, food, drinks, everything was spectacular. The food was delicious! We loved what they have created at this small restaurant. Highly recommended! We hope to come back again one day!
reviews.title: Spectacular experience

reviews.review_text:
We went out of the way to Barranco for a dinner at Mérito and it did not disappoint.

We had two main dishes, "oyster mushroom rice with asparragus and Andesino pesto", and "glazed pork belly with arepas". The rice dish was very good. The pork with arepas (corn dough stuffed with meat) was a bit cultue shock to me as a Chinese. We have something similar called roujiamo back at home. The pork belly was delicious, but I find it a bit difficult to eat it that way.

The dessert "corn and coffee cloud with lucuma and macambo" was very creative and delicious.

Service was a bit hit and miss. One gentleman was very nice. He explained the dishes very well and answered all my questions. Some other staff members were not proactive at all. I would expect better service for a restaurant ranked at 59 in the world.

We spent around US$30 per person, without any drinks. It was not cheap for Peru, but very reasonable compared to similar food back at home.
reviews.title: Good food at a reasonable price

reviews.review_text:
After 1 1/2 hours we had received one single starter, which was not harmonic in taste.

We were HUNGRY, asked when the other dishes should come. The waiter said ‚when they come, they come‘. Since the guests next table told us they were sitting already since 2 1/2 hours we asked for the bill.

When leaving we informed the owner why we‘re leaving and he just said ‚ok‘, no excuse, no explanation.

This restaurant is living for its previous reputation, the owner is trying to squeeze out of his reputation as much as he can.
reviews.title: Inacceptable, rude, SLOW

reviews.review_text: Amazing Food, great atmosphere and very professional service. We loved it! We had lunch there (2 people) and had such a hard time deciding what to order as everything on the menu looked great. Our waiter helped us with clear recommendations and we were able to start by ordering a few starters and deciding on the go after that. We ended up splitting four starters and one main and one dessert. The dessert flan was spectacular!
reviews.title: Lovely lunch in Barranco district

reviews.review_text:
Certainly the best restaurant we have been to even though we are used to Michelin-starred restaurants. The service is impeccable, the different dishes succulent, our taste buds were delighted.

To discover
reviews.title: Perfect way to end our vacation

reviews.review_text:
If I could rate this restaurant with more than 5 stars, I would! A small, stylish and utterly delightful restaurant located in the upmarket area of Barranco. Reservations a must to secure a booking. The Chef Patron, Juan Luis Martinez and the team underneath him are geniuses. The restaurant is ranked 11th in South America and 59th in the world. Would not surprise me if it pushes even higher. 

Service is second to none - thoroughly professional, superbly trained and knowledgeable, polite and friendly. 

As for the food… I can describe this in one word: sublime! But I will use more. This restaurant provides a deep dive into Peruvian and South American cuisine, taking local dishes and elevating them to fine dining. Moreish and enlightening your taste buds. Devine. Memorable. Outstanding. 

We were just wowed. This sits there as one of the best restaurants we have ever eaten at. This is a perfect example of how food and service should be delivered. Bravo!
reviews.title: Utterly delightful and sublime!

reviews.review_text: Excellent food, very nice experience, drinks are very good. Prices vs quality very well balanced. The pancetta was amazing, Negroni was very good!please order the “tostadas”
reviews.title: Tasting Merito

reviews.review_text: The place is special. Small, charming and cozy. The kitchen is great. You don't force yourself to face a sequence of dishes. The menu features 9 starters, 5 main courses and 5 desserts. And you ask for what you want. The ideal is to order several dishes and share. All very good. Great wines by the glass. Worth the visit.
reviews.title: Friendly and cozy

reviews.review_text:
Potentially the best restaurant I've ever been to - would be 2 Michelin starred if Michelin covered Peru.

Sit at the Chef's counter if possible and order as many dishes as you can - especially the Fish Curry.

You have to book in advance - but always worth sending a Whatsapp on the day if it's last minute.

Can't recommend enough
reviews.title: One of the best restaurants I've ever been to (so good I went twice)

reviews.review_text: Wonderful food and service, the portions are not large, but they are very tasty, the drinks are excellent, just the furniture is not very comfortable.
reviews.title: Minimalist and powerful

reviews.review_text:
We chose the 8 pm shift and I arrived before my wife. I stood outside until a waiter came out and asked: have they opened, YES are we already open? It was then that a woman came out asking if I had a reservation, I gave her the information and passed.
I greeted 10 people who were in the kitchen with a kind and necessary good night and only ONE person answered. I imagine the concentration when preparing your dishes required that degree of absence from external reality, so I got excited and thought: what good dishes await us.
Luis served us, very friendly and descriptive with the dishes, but he had no idea which dish to serve and/or offer first, which we paid for with a mix of hot and cold dishes that left a lot to miss, longing for Merito from when it wasn't award-winning that it was when we went up to 3 times and we always liked it. This time it was not the case. I don't know if the main chef is so worried about this recognition that he forgot the essential thing about his food: the flavor! and replaced it with the presentation. Thank you but we hope not to return soon
reviews.title: 'Disappointment after recognition

reviews.review_text:
As soon as you enter the place you are captivated by the decoration, it is like being inside a ruin, the tables according to the walls, the A1 tableware, the attentive service, the menu is not very varied, but each dish surprises you in the flavor, the presentation and quality of inputs.
They have natural infusions, signature cocktails and an interesting wine list, love the curved glasses without a base for the wine.
Prices according to the place.
Highly recommended.
reviews.title: Elegantly rustic, exquisite, unique.

reviews.review_text: Exceptional! A must in Lima, the dinner experience in the kitchen is the best! All the preparation is very careful, the sweetbreads and the bacon arepas are the best!
reviews.title: Incredible experience

reviews.review_text: Came given all the great reviews but think it’s a bit overhyped. It’s decent but portion sizes are quite small and the flavors aren’t particularly special. It’s different from many other spots we’ve tried in Lima in that they use international flavors (some drinks were reminiscent of HK and the food had some Thai flavors), so I could see this being a good spot for locals / others living in Lima that are craving some non-Peruvian flavors, but if you’re a tourist and visiting, I wouldn’t recommend. For example, their pork dish basically tasted like a pork bun (except this had arepas) that you could get in many Chinese restaurants in NY. Their fish was a bit over cooked so it had a rubbery texture.
reviews.title: Decent meal with international fusion

reviews.review_text:
Unique experience, a restaurant with author's cuisine in which everyone who attends explains every step and every ingredient of preparation.
100% recommended
reviews.title: Unbelievable

reviews.review_text: The place is cozy. Since you come in, they recommend you share dishes. We order 4 entries, 1 second and 2 posters. Spectacular, it's like an à la carte tasting menu. The average price per person was 190 soles. Don't stop trying the glazed pancake.
